decks.notes: The primary focus of this deck is to control the game through countering spells, removing threats, and drawing cards with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and creatures like Narset, Parter of Veils. The inclusion of cards like Isochron Scepter and Force of Negation helps to maintain control over the game, while cards like Solitude and Supreme Verdict provide board control against aggressive decks. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes utility lands like Geier Reach Sanitarium and Monumental Henge to provide additional advantages.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of artifact creatures and powerful artifacts. By utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Emry, Lurker of the Loch, you can quickly draw cards and ramp up your board presence. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Metallic Rebuke and Portable Hole to control the opponent's actions. With a strong mana base and the ability to generate additional artifacts with cards like Urza's Saga, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells and Eldrazi creatures to control the board and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. By utilizing mana acceleration and high-impact Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, the deck aims to control the pace of the game while grinding out advantages with cards like Kozilek's Return and Sowing Mycospawn. With a mix of removal, ramp, and big threats, the deck looks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in the late game.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. These creatures, such as Griselbrand and Emperor of Bones, can be brought back at instant speed to surprise and overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes cards like Leyline Binding and Force of Negation to protect these reanimation spells and ensure the combo can go off smoothly. Additionally, there are cards like Psychic Frog and Fallaji Archaeologist to provide card advantage and control the board.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies, utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Galvanic Discharge to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes versatile spells like Seasoned Pyromancer and Thraben Charm to maintain board control. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer adds additional pressure to the opponent. The deck aims to create a fast-paced, aggressive game plan to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent and controlling the board by using cards like Thoughtseize, Prismatic Ending, and Fatal Push. It also leverages the Death and Taxes strategy of taxing the opponent's resources while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Flickerwisp and Emperor of Bones. The deck also utilizes flicker effects like Ephemerate to generate value from enter-the-battlefield effects. The inclusion of graveyard hate with Relic of Progenitus and versatile removal options allows the deck to adapt to various matchups in the Modern format.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with disruptive elements to control the pace of the game. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also being able to deploy efficient threats like Flickerwisp and Emperor of Bones, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while also disrupting their strategy. Aether Vial helps to cheat creatures into play quickly, while cards like Solitude and Witch Enchanter provide additional removal and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with a combination of counterspells, removal, and hand disruption while utilizing card advantage and powerful threats like Murktide Regent to win the game. The deck aims to control the game through counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Negation, removal spells like Fatal Push and Dismember, and disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Sink into Stupor. Additionally, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and psychic frog provide card advantage, while Orcish Bowmasters and Subtlety offer ways to deal with opposing threats.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponent's plans with a variety of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. The deck aims to control the board state through cards like Counterspell, Thoughtseize, and Fatal Push while also developing its own threats like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. By denying the opponent resources and maintaining a strong defensive position, this deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver opponents to secure a victory in a slower, more methodical manner.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively play creatures and utilize blink effects to repeatedly enter the battlefield to gain advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can constantly flicker important creatures like Solitude and Overlord of the Balemurk to control the board. Combined with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while maintaining control of the game through blink effects and removal.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game with board wipes and removal spells. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures like Emrakul, Ulamog, and Kozilek, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command. The deck uses Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to accelerate mana production, allowing you to cast your Eldrazi threats ahead of schedule and dominate the battlefield.

The deck relies on a combination of instant and sorcery spells to disrupt opponents while utilizing powerful creatures and artifacts to quickly win the game without relying on traditional lands. By utilizing cards like Disrupting Shoal and Spell Snare to counter opponent's spells, and cards like Thundertrap Trainer and Goblin Charbelcher to deal damage directly to the opponent, the deck aims to create a fast and overwhelming win condition. The inclusion of cards like Lotus Bloom and Whir of Invention help to accelerate this strategy, creating a unique and aggressive combo-focused playstyle.

The key focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and disruption. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Sink into Stupor, while also having a strong counter package with Force of Negation and Counterspell. The deck also utilizes creatures like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares to put pressure on the opponent. By controlling the game and disrupting the opponent's strategy, the deck aims to out-value and outlast the opponent in a longer game.

This deck revolves around utilizing various counterspells and disruption cards to protect and enable the combo of casting Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck includes a mix of counter magic, card draw, and tutoring to find and assemble the pieces needed to execute the combo efficiently and effectively. By strategically managing resources and timing spells, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition through the powerful combo of Goblin Charbelcher and other supporting cards.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize combo pieces and spells to create a powerful win condition without the need for traditional lands. By using cards like Disrupting Shoal, Whir of Invention, and Thundertrap Trainer, the deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary components for a devastating combo finish. The deck seeks to control the game through disruption and denial while generating mana and card advantage with cards like Sea Gate Restoration and Lotus Bloom. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful combo using cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Tameshi, Reality Architect.

The main idea of this UW control deck is to utilize powerful control tools like counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers to control the pace of the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to establish board control, manage the opponent's threats, and win through card advantage and powerful finishers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Solitude. The inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional support and synergy for the deck's overall game plan. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's strategy and provide consistent access to its powerful spells.
